_rationale: 97 wrapped 60-year windows of 60/40 history with no withdrawals. 60 years of compounding produces enormous range (a 5% real CAGR on $500k yields ~$9M; 7% yields ~$30M). Wrap enables runs that wouldn't otherwise fit, exposing more of the late-data tail to early-data conditions. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance. Range is very wide because long-horizon historical compounding spans roughly 60-year windows of widely different real outcomes.
